facts.subject: Myth: the Great Wall of China is visible from space / from the Moon with the naked eye. Origin: a 1932 Ripley's 'Believe It or Not' cartoon called it 'the only one that would be visible to the human eye from the moon' (LiveScience, 'Since at least 1932'); NASA: the Moon theory 'dates back to at least 1938' → say 'ən azı 1930-cu illərdən'. Gagarin flew 12 Apr 1961 → the myth is 20+ years older than human spaceflight. Facts: China's first astronaut Yang Liwei (Shenzhou 5, Oct 2003, 14 orbits, ~21 h): 'But I didn't see the Great Wall' (Al Jazeera 17 Oct 2003; Scientific American names Shenzhou 5/2003). Wall is roughly 6 m wide (Al Jazeera; LiveScience 'less than 20 feet (6 meters) wide' for most of it) and similar in colour to its surroundings. ISS altitude ~400 km (LiveScience). Moon ~384 000 km (we say 'təxminən 380 000 km'; LiveScience 370 000 — keep 'yüz minlərlə km' if in doubt). Apollo 12's Alan Bean: 'No man-made object is visible at this scale' (NASA, from the Moon). What IS visible from low orbit: cities at night, airports/runways, major roads, bridges, dams (NASA + Scientific American). First confirmed photo: Leroy Chiao from the ISS, 24 Nov 2004, 180 mm lens + digital camera, and he himself 'didn't see the wall' (NASA). NOT used: 21 196 km length (not in our sources), hair/cable analogy (LiveScience only), Stukeley 1754, Ripley's 1904.

facts.subject: Baku–Tbilisi–Ceyhan (BTC) oil pipeline. Length 1 768 km: Azerbaijan 443 km, Georgia 249 km, Türkiye 1 076 km (bp.com BTC page + Wikipedia). Highest point 2 830 m (bp 2021 release + Wikipedia; bp 2006 said 2 800 m). Crosses 'more than 1 500 watercourses up to 500 metres wide' (bp 2021) / '1,500 watercourses' (Wikipedia). Filling the line took 10 million barrels of oil (bp 2006 release + Wikipedia). First oil reached Ceyhan at 23:00 Baku time on 28 May 2006 (bp 2006 release); first tanker British Hawthorn (~600 000 barrels). 8 pump stations (bp + Wikipedia). Buried at least 1 m (Wikipedia). Cost US$3.9 bn (Wikipedia only → NOT in voice). Cumulative: 4 billion barrels on 18 Jan 2023 (bp BTC page). Capacity 1.2 million barrels/day (bp). Since 1 July 2026 the operator is SOCAR (a SOCAR subsidiary), taking over from bp after ~20 years (azertag.az 'BTC announces transition of operatorship', report.az 'BP transfers BTC operatorship to SOCAR subsidiary', intellinews). Wikipedia: oil flows ~2 m/s → ≈10 days end to end (our own derivation, single source → NOT in voice).
